title: Product Safety Manager
desc:
Job Description
s being one of the core brand of Rolls Royce Power Systems, Rolls Royce Solutions Turkey is equipped with the experience of more than 100 years on productions of diesel engines, manufactures and improves complete drive systems, Gas and Diesel Systems and their control / monitoring systems in wide range of product types and power ratings for heavy vehicles and equipment for construction and mining industry.
We are looking for Product Safety Manager;
Key Responsibilities
Act as the main point of contact for all safety-related topics in assigned projects, including Functional Safety, Product Safety, and HS&E matters
Coordinate project and product safety activities with internal stakeholders, customers, and external partners
Analyze safety requirements based on customer specifications, standards, regulations, and internal procedures; implement the safety lifecycle and prepare the Project Safety Management Plan
Lead safety planning, monitoring, and control activities; ensure internal and external reporting and coordinate corrective actions in case of deviations
Support and guide project teams in safety analyses, documentation, and compliance processes
Provide safety and HS&E input during proposal preparation and sales processes
Conduct on-site assessments during production, testing, and commissioning phases; initiate and coordinate improvement actions when required
Collaborate with global R&D teams to ensure implementation of defined Product Safety lifecycle work packages
Manage external service providers when internal resources are limited and ensure proper coordination with project managers
Ensure compliance with global Product Safety procedures, standards, and Quality Gate (QG) processes
Drive continuous improvement of product safety management practices for new technologies and the existing product portfolio
Maintain documentation, traceability, reporting, and archiving in line with global standards
Support supplier alignment with internal safety and quality processes
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or related fields)
5–10 years of experience in Product Safety, Functional Safety, or Engineering project environments
Knowledge of Product Safety Management, risk assessment, CE marking, and HS&E practices
Experience in complex technical systems such as diesel generators, dynamic UPS, gas engine generators, cogeneration and trigeneration systems is preferred
Strong understanding of engineering drawings, P&ID diagrams, and system interfaces
Familiarity with safety tools and software (MS Office, CAD/CAM, Safeexpert, etc.)
Experience working with global standards and structured lifecycle processes
Project management and stakeholder coordination experience
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
Effective communication and negotiation skills
Fluent in English (German is a plus)
Willingness to travel when required
Valid driving license
Type of Contract
Permanent
